item_name: Rothco Sport Duffle Carry On Bag
description: Rothco’s 21” Sport Duffle Carry On is constructed of durable 600 Denier Polyester and is designed to go beyond your weekend trip. With a spacious 14.5" x 9.25" main compartment, dual side zippered compartments and a front zippered pocket, this bag will accommodate all your gear. Other features include built in base pegs, a top carry handle, and removable shoulder straps.
